tool_plans.name: issues_search
tool_plans.rationale: Search Linear issues / projects / cycles by free-text query (Linear GraphQL search resolvers).

tool_plans.name: objects_fetch
tool_plans.rationale: Retrieve a single Issue, Project, or Cycle by smart ID.

tool_plans.name: collections_list
tool_plans.rationale: Discover top-level collections (Teams, Projects, Cycles) for the workspace.

tool_plans.name: objects_list
tool_plans.rationale: List Issues with cursor pagination and filter (Linear GraphQL pageInfo.endCursor).

tool_plans.name: objects_upsert
tool_plans.rationale: Create or update an Issue (issueCreate / issueUpdate mutations).

tool_plans.name: objects_delete
tool_plans.rationale: Permanently delete an Issue (issueDelete mutation; archival uses dedicated action).

tool_plans.name: issues_create_with_relations
tool_plans.rationale: Create an Issue with parent / blocking relations atomically — does not fit plain upsert (relation links require coordinated set).

tool_plans.name: issues_archive
tool_plans.rationale: Archive an Issue (destructive+idempotent per _archive Appendix B verb pattern; preserves audit trail vs delete).

tool_plans.name: cycles_advance
tool_plans.rationale: Roll the active Cycle forward (not idempotent — advancing twice produces side effects).
